description: Nozomi's regular date conversations: all of SERIFU/DATE_KY.BIN (girl 6, load address 0x80198000; section/place map in game-internals 6k, `tools/date_sections.py --girl 6`), 464 strings including the ones the dumper misses; pure-punctuation pause lines stay in Japanese. Same 27-section layout as Shiori's and Yuko's files. Options and thought endings are even-length; with an odd-length name nothing follows {G} on its line (an option ending on the name shows a space before the bracket, accepted). Identical lines share one copy. Verified in DuckStation on forced dates (date_run.ps1 -Girl 6 -Version -1, hidden; docs/testing.md 'The other girls' dates'): meeting on time, every place 0-20, each with its first choice, her reply and verdict, the player's answer and the way home. Checked only statically: other versions, later choices, moods, being late, natural triggers. Her date events are in nozomi_events.json; the impression thoughts in date_shared.json.
